description: 与奥丁、威利共同参与创世的兄弟神之一。
fullDescription: 维的来源同样没有给出稳定独立外观。本卡应避免把后世词源或现代阐释当作确定神职，重点表现三兄弟共同创世中的第三位独立主体。
roleInSeries: 完成创世三兄弟的人物闭环。

sourceRefs.note: 维与奥丁、威利共同杀死尤弥尔并塑造世界。

visualThesis: 相比威利更稳定、收束的创世姿态：清晰独立脸型，双手或身体姿态强调定位、支撑、安排，而不是魔法法阵。

sourceBoundFacts: 与奥丁、威利共同参与创世
来源未提供明确独立外观
interpretationNotes: ‘神圣空间/秩序’可作为视觉解释，不是来源明确的本场景神职
不凭词源给他添加无来源法器
canon.worldState: 世界正在形成；不得提前出现成熟神殿、王城或礼仪体系。

instructions: 与奥丁：无王者符号、无独眼
与威利：更稳定垂直构图、更少冲刺感，脸与体型必须不同

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、双手和支撑动作高细节；环境低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 使用轮廓与背景雾化分离，不靠发光魔法。

prompt.draft: Create Vé as the third distinct creator brother, a normal-scale humanlike god with a calm, stabilizing world-making pose. He must not look like Odin or Vili: use a different face, hairstyle, build and posture. Express order through physical placement, support or arrangement of raw world materials, not magic circles or glowing runes. No one-eye trait, throne, crown, staff, battle armor or priest stereotype. Unfinished world background only, simple and low-detail. Painterly, restrained, crop-safe, subject-first.
prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone portrait 9:16 pure artwork for card 1003010006, Vé / 维, type character.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: Create Vé as the third distinct creator brother, a normal-scale humanlike god with a calm, stabilizing world-making pose. He must not look like Odin or Vili: use a different face, hairstyle, build and posture. Express order through physical placement, support or arrangement of raw world materials, not magic circles or glowing runes. No one-eye trait, throne, crown, staff, battle armor or priest stereotype. Unfinished world background only, simple and low-detail. Painterly, restrained, crop-safe, subject-first.

Visual thesis: 相比威利更稳定、收束的创世姿态：清晰独立脸型，双手或身体姿态强调定位、支撑、安排，而不是魔法法阵。

Identity anchors: 独立脸型；稳定造物姿态；正常神祇尺度

Must keep: 姿态更沉稳；服饰简洁；不使用魔法UI

Must avoid: 奥丁换脸；威利换脸；魔法法阵；祭司法杖；王冠；重甲维京人

Composition: camera eye level; shot stable three-quarter; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 灰白；深蓝灰；少量土褐; materials 石；木；粗织物; mood stable；ordering；quiet；restrained.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010004；1003010005. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: Odin clone；Vili clone；one eye；throne；crown；magic circle；glowing runes；priest staff；Viking armor；typography；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
prompt.notes: 差异化优先：三兄弟必须看起来是三位不同的人，而不是同一角色换脸/换色。

references.notes: 生成前必须查看相关已批准角色，继承系列画风但避免复制脸型、体量、姿态和环境模板。
